name: Aikawa Chinatsu
source:
[i]“A Bright & Caring Girl”[/i]

A highly sociable girl who serves as the poster girl for a local Japanese inn. She happily steps up to take care of the newly arrived Shuuji.

She proactively closes the distance between them by showing him around the village and greeting his grandmother.

Although she is bright, innocent, and hits it off with Shuuji right away, she definitely has ulterior motives and can't quite hide the fact that she's setting her sights on him...

[b][i]“I think it’s totally fine for you to stay as long as you like. As for me, you’re more than welcome!”[/i]
